title: Motivators and Barriers to Physical Activity in Knee Osteoarthritis Patients: a Qualitative Study
brief_summary: This study sought to better identify the motivators and barriers to osteoarthritic patients practising regular physical activity. This is a crucial step towards enabling each health professional to adapt their therapy recommendations, while taking into account the patient's overall lifestyle.
